run_note: The operator's folder was named run, copied into the snapshot ahead of the run and identical to the package. It follows a void attempt the same morning (void-2), whose client had been logged out. The client ran in its auto permission mode and never compacted the main session; the operator sent nothing after the fixed first message and closed the client after the delivery. Eight of the 105 subagents had a response stopped by the safety classifier, and the client switched each of them to claude-sonnet-5; those turns produced 203,558 of the run's output tokens and US$ 4.43 of its US$ 171.18, and their one file edit went to a scratch copy, not to the delivery. The delivery itself, code, report and findings index, was written by Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the main session, which never switched, so the run stands (PROTOCOL §3), as run 1 did. Run 1 took 8.1 h with 7 workflows and 68 subagents; this run took 2.0 h with 2 workflows.
